2607.08284.title: Understanding Axes of Difficulty For Long Context Tasks Via PredicateLongBench
2607.08284.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated rapidly improving long-context capabilities, prompting a wave of benchmarks designed to evaluate them. However, existing long-context evaluations - from Needle-in-a-Haystack (NIAH) tests to more recent multi-hop reasoning and summarization tasks - predominantly measure average-case performance, and many are either saturated or lack robustness. Notably absent is a systematic way to probe how models perform as we scale up the difficulty of tasks along various axes. We address this gap by proposing PredicateLongBench, a benchmark that stress-tests long-context reasoning by asking models to identify the longest contiguous subsequence of words in a long input that satisfies given predicates/constraints (e.g., lexicographic ordering), drawn from a broader predicate class. The central innovation of our benchmark is the identification and systematic exploration of multiple different axes of difficulty which test multiple aspects of long context understanding. We provide two complementary generation pipelines - a fully synthetic setup using random word-like strings, and a real-world setup that samples words from natural documents while preserving their distributional properties. We find that frontier models struggle to perform well as we scale up the difficulty of tasks along our axes, demonstrating the utility of our benchmark in understanding the limitations of current long-context capabilities. Furthermore, the tasks in PredicateLongBench, though challenging, are conceptually simple and do not require LLM-based generations or judges.
2607.08284.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）已顯示出快速改善的長上下文能力，促使了一波旨在評估它們的基準測試。然而，現有的長上下文評估——從 Needle-in-a-Haystack (NIAH) 測試到最近的多跳推理和摘要任務——主要測量平均情況下的表現，許多測試要麼已經飽和，要麼缺乏穩健性。顯著缺乏的是一種系統性的方法來探查模型在我們沿著各個軸線提高任務難度時的表現。我們通過提出 PredicateLongBench 來填補這一空白，這是一個通過要求模型識別長輸入中滿足給定謂詞/約束（例如，字典序）的最長連續子序列來進行壓力測試長上下文推理的基準測試，這些謂詞來自更廣泛的謂詞類別。我們基準的核心創新在於識別和系統性探索多個不同的難度軸，測試長上下文理解的多個方面。我們提供了兩個互補的生成管道——一個是使用隨機類似單詞字符串的完全合成設置，另一個是真實世界設置，從自然文檔中抽樣單詞，同時保留它們的分佈特性。我們發現，前沿模型在我們沿著這些軸線提高任務難度時表現不佳，這顯示了我們基準在理解當前長上下文能力限制方面的實用性。此外，PredicateLongBench 中的任務雖然具有挑戰性，但概念上簡單，並不需要基於 LLM 的生成或評判。
